user.title: Connect to Contarina SOL
user.description: Sign in to the Contarina SOL portal in your browser and provide the accessToken JWT. Do not enter your portal password. The token expires after 55 minutes unless the integration refreshes it.

contracts.title: Select contracts
contracts.description: Choose which contracts Home Assistant should monitor.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Contarina
reauth_confirm.description: The SOL session expired. Log in again via the browser and enter a fresh accessToken.

error.invalid_contracts: Select at least one valid contract

abort.reauth_wrong_account: This token belongs to another account
